gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
'I'll definitely call you when I land,' she told me.
gaps.explanation: Reported promise: promised to call; the person promised shifts to 'me'.

gaps.lead: Her French improved because she spent years in Lyon.
gaps.sentence: Her French improved as ___ in Lyon.
gaps.explanation: as a result of + noun/-ing = because of.

gaps.lead: The exam regulations forbid the use of mobile phones.
'Don't touch the paintings in this room,' the guide warned us.
gaps.sentence: The guide warned ___ the paintings in that room.
gaps.explanation: Negative commands are reported with warned + object + not to + infinitive.

gaps.lead: Fewer students enrolled this year than we expected.
gaps.explanation: fewer than expected = not as many (students) as expected.
